# Description

The purpose of this pecification is to produce material that can be used to train and 
successfully pass the Microsoft exam and certification:
`SC-100: Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Microsoft`

Using the information 

- all the contents from the Microsoft Learn sites that refer to the exam
- all the information from the references in the sections Microsoft Learn and Learning Paths below
- the videos listed in the section named playlist below 
- all the contents from this code repository that refer to this exam and certification
- all the information about the exam and certification available on the Internet which is relevant and reputable  

---

# Task 01

Produce a document called `SC-100-tests.md` with questions that are of the same
type and level of complexity that can be encountered on the real Microsoft exam. 

Questions may be of the following types:

- any of the question formats that are normally used in the official exam from Microsoft
- multiple choice with none ,one or more correct answers
- design tasks with different degree of complexity

Each question should be followed by: 

- the correct answer, 
- the reasons that make it the correct answer,
- the sources and references that make the answer correct
- any wrong answer
- the reasons that make it a wrong answer,
- the sources and references that make the answer incorrect
